# Code of conduct

This project is a welcoming, safe and equitable space for everyone who takes
part in good faith. That holds whatever a person's race, ethnicity, caste,
color, age, disability, neurodiversity, sex, gender identity or expression,
sexual orientation, language, religion, origin, class or education.

The following behavior is not accepted, and neither are threats of it:

- Violating someone's stated boundaries, or continuing personal attention after a request to stop.
- Insulting, demeaning or pejorative comments aimed at a person or a group.
- Characterizing anyone's personality or behavior on the basis of identity or traits.
- Behavior that is inappropriately intimate for the context.
- Sharing or acting on someone's private information without permission.
- Causing, encouraging or threatening violence or other harm.
- Impersonating someone, failing to credit sources, or posting commercial content outside the norms of the project.

Report a problem privately to the maintainer,
[@preller](https://github.com/preller). Reports are handled in confidence.
